openGaps.statement: Natural image neighbors and controlled numeric memory scenarios do not prove representative natural-language memory usefulness.
Process exits at registered write boundaries do not prove behavior under physical power loss or storage-controller cache loss.
Managed active files are scanned after cleanup, but free-space, journal, snapshot, and forensic media erasure are outside this experiment.
No compressed retrieval method or TurboVec implementation is compared in this baseline observation.

requiredNextGate: Only after this exact baseline passes may one independently source-pinned compressed numerical comparison arm be preregistered at equal effective bytes. Product semantic-memory usefulness still requires the selected embedding model, a separately sealed natural-language corpus, untouched downstream conversations, and human authority.
